name: image-weight-guard
description: Blocks Webflow CMS item writes (data_cms_tool create/update_collection_items) and asset uploads (asset_tool upload_image_by_url) that carry an image over 400 KB or not WebP/AVIF/SVG, checked by HEAD before the image is loaded; asks when size or type cannot be determined. Fix: route through generated-image-intake (LC-1883).
